scripts.build-storybook: storybook build -o storybook-static && cp storybook-public/robots.txt storybook-static/robots.txt && rm -f storybook-static/_headers && sed -i 's|<meta name="viewport"|<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow" /><meta name="viewport"|' storybook-static/index.html storybook-static/iframe.html
scripts.test:lh: node scripts/serve-dist.mjs dist 8080 & sleep 1; npx lighthouse http://127.0.0.1:8080/ --only-categories=performance,accessibility,best-practices,seo --budget-path=lighthouse-budget.json --chrome-flags=--headless=new --output=json --output-path=lh-report.json --quiet; RC=$?; kill %1 2>/dev/null; exit $RC
scripts.test:storybook: npm run build-storybook && (node scripts/serve-dist.mjs storybook-static 6006 & sleep 2; npx test-storybook --url http://127.0.0.1:6006; RC=$?; kill %1 2>/dev/null; exit $RC)
